ARK Trust's 9.98% of Class B also includes 156,252,115 Class B shares held for other trusts, which is not added. LARGEST HOLDERS: BlackRock is listed at 5.16% of Class B only (basis 'class'), so it is not used for 'everyone else'. Co-founder and director Lin Bin is disclosed only per class (448,404,962 Class A, 9.94%, via Apex Star LLC; Class B interests of 7.93%, 0.43%, 0.24% and 0.14%), and combining them would be a derivation the schema does not allow for holders. DIVIDENDS: none paid; the Board resolved not to declare a final dividend for 2025. The RMB 1,964k paid to non-controlling interests is excluded. BUYBACKS: the cash-flow line 'Payments for shares repurchase' (RMB 6,172,545k); the treasury-share note shows RMB 6,585,318k of shares repurchased in 2025 on a trade basis. In March 2025 Xiaomi also placed 800,000,000 new Class B shares (HK$42.6 billion gross). STOCK COMP: the Note 9 employee benefit line (RMB 5,365,075k).

Two employee bases overlap and are kept under separate metrics: the MD&A says 53,901 full-time employees were in the Chinese Mainland, while the ESG table counts 54,122 in 'Chinese Mainland, Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan' (the report names these four, so that region carries a country list). Sites: the Beijing headquarters is re-sourced to the 2025 report; the Changping smartphone factory and the Wuhan smart home appliance factory keep their 2024 Annual Report sources, because the 2025 report mentions both factories but not their locations.
